checks.name: format
checks.protects: Every code and settings file is laid out the one Prettier way, so a change shows only what it really changes.
checks.misses: Markdown and kit-managed files (left out in .prettierignore), and anything about what the code does.

checks.name: oxlint
checks.run: pnpm exec oxlint -f json . | node kit-lint/hints.mjs
checks.protects: Common bugs and risky patterns Oxlint knows, such as unused variables and unreachable code.
checks.misses: The kit's own rules and plugin rules Oxlint does not support; ESLint runs those.

checks.name: eslint
checks.run: pnpm exec eslint -f json . | node kit-lint/hints.mjs
checks.protects: The kit's own rules (comment ban, no skipped tests, no missing packages) and plugin rules Oxlint lacks.
checks.misses: Rules Oxlint already runs (switched off here so nothing runs twice), and wrong logic.

checks.name: tsc
checks.protects: Values used as the wrong type, missing fields, and calls with the wrong arguments.
checks.misses: Wrong values of the right type, and data from outside the program that is never checked.

checks.name: test
checks.run: echo 'Fill in this check: put the project test command in scripts/kit.config.json' >&2; exit 1
checks.protects: Behavior the tests describe; fill in the project's test command.
checks.misses: Behavior no test describes, and tests that pass whatever the code does.

checks.name: pnpm audit
checks.protects: Installed packages with a known security hole.
checks.misses: Holes nobody has reported yet, and needs the network to run.

switchOffs.what: eslint-disable comment switches off an ESLint rule
oxlint-disable comment switches off an Oxlint rule
@ts-ignore switches off the type check on the next line
@ts-expect-error switches off the type check on the next line
@ts-nocheck switches off the type check for the whole file
a coverage ignore comment hides code from the test coverage count

skippedTests.what: Jest or Vitest skip, focus, or todo marker, written with a dot or in brackets
Jest x or f prefix that skips or focuses a test
Node test runner option that skips or focuses a test
Node test runner call that skips a running test

testNames.what: the name given to describe, it, test, or suite, with x or f in front, a marker after a dot or in brackets, or after .skipIf(x) or .runIf(x)

flakyWorkarounds.what: jest.setTimeout, test.setTimeout, or this.timeout sets a time limit
Playwright setDefaultTimeout sets a time limit
a timeout in the options object given straight to a test, a suite, or describe.configure sets a time limit
testTimeout, hookTimeout, or teardownTimeout sets a time limit
a timeout key in the test settings sets a time limit
a number after a test body is its time limit (Jest, Vitest)
a number after a one-line test body is its time limit
a promise that resolves after a setTimeout is a fixed wait
setTimeout(resolve, ms) is a fixed wait
await setTimeout(ms) from node:timers/promises is a fixed wait
sleep, delay, or wait with a number is a fixed wait
Playwright waitForTimeout is a fixed wait
jest.retryTimes runs a failing test again
a retry in the options object given straight to a test, a suite, or describe.configure runs a failing test again
a retries or retry key in the test settings runs failing tests again
this.retries runs a failing test again (Mocha)
